newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends lower in volatile trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends lower in volatile trade.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed lower at 35.69/70 per dollar on Friday in tight range, dealers said.
"The market was volatile, very hectic," said one dealer.
Traders said the central bank bought dollars at 35.65/66. There was also demand from a major state-run bank at 35.65-35.70.
The forward premia fell below 6 percent to close at 5.82 percent in anticipation of higher inflows from expatriate Indians and easing liquidity conditions, traders said.
The annualised premia was quoted at 0.77 percent for December, 2.39 percent for January, 4.09 percent for February, 4.86 for March, 5.59 percent for April, and 5.72 percent for May, dealers said.
